title: Crispy Pork Knuckle Tacos
description: A fusion of warm, Uruguayan flavors with a Mexican twist, wrapped in a crispy tortilla.
instructions: Season pork knuckle with salt and black pepper.
Sear pork knuckle in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer pork knuckle to the oven and roast until tender and crispy, about 30-40 minutes.
Meanwhile, warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Once pork knuckle is cooked, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing into thin strips.
Assemble tacos by placing sliced pork knuckle onto a warmed tortilla, then topping with uruguayan chimichurri sauce, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice.
